name: control-framework-mapping
description: Map existing or planned controls against one or more control frameworks (ISO 27001 Annex A, SOC 2 TSC, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS Controls, PCI-DSS, HIPAA Security Rule, NIS2). Produces coverage matrix per framework, gap analysis, evidence mapping per control, cross-framework consolidation (one control → many framework cells), and maturity scoring. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
